scope: First completed seed only; not the study final visual review

observations.observation: Table and whiteboard regions show lower broad-area relative error, while chair rims and occlusion edges remain bright. Wall error map gains RGB-texture-like variations; no general boundary-sharpness improvement established.
Overall relative error worsens from about .0481 to .0574. Coffee-table surface and back-wall regions become brighter in the error map; table-leg detail remains incomplete.
Overall error worsens from about .0882 to .1195. Chair and right counter remain high-error areas; flat-wall error becomes more textured. The correction has not repaired the missing/thin geometry.

Large improvement from about .5841 to .4031, especially background wall and person region, but substantial errors remain on foreground furniture and left branches. This is a scale/value correction benefit with persistent hard geometry.
Broad wall/floor error decreases (.1129 to .0945); narrow shelf and foreground contours retain local error. Ceiling/right background saturated errors remain.
Near unchanged overall error (.0986 to .0996). Shelf region changes locally; curtain/wall error becomes textured. No clear net geometry benefit.

curve_review: Validation improves to best at step900, then fluctuates higher until patience stop1900 while online train loss continues to fall. This is consistent with a generalization/overfitting warning, not proof of its cause. The predefined stable-at-end criterion is not met.
quantitative_context: Validation AbsRel .1208456 -> .1014749; macro boundary F1 .4511548 -> .4585025; boundary-band AbsRel .1830471 -> .1606758. One seed does not establish seed-stable gains.
